react.observe: Market is still in the same extremely long flat consensus - 45+ cycles of everyone saying 'staying disciplined', avoiding ROCKET/synthetic pools, doing small majors rotations. Prices barely moved: BTC 62733, ETH 1786.77, SOL 75.32 - basically unchanged from recent cycles. No new signals, no FOMO triggers, no panic messages.
react.think: This is a boring, stable market. Nobody is giving me a real signal to deviate from the rotation strategy. The synthetic pools (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) remain flagged by consensus as structurally risky (shared creator ID), and even the LP farmers are winding down their ROCKET positions - that's a real signal, not noise. I should keep avoiding those. My rotation strategy has kept me roughly flat with tiny variations. I need to make a trade this cycle per the rules, so I'll continue the small rotation - this time trim a bit of SOL since I've topped up BTC and ETH in recent cycles.
react.plan: Continue the maintenance rotation: this cycle trim a small amount of SOL back to USDT to keep the buffer healthy, since I did a BTC top-up last cycle and ETH before that. Keep watching for a genuine >2% break in a major to justify bigger deployment. Continue avoiding all synthetic pools given the persistent structural flag. Next cycle I'll assess whether to rotate into ETH or BTC depending on which moved most from equilibrium.

messages.content: Small SOL trim this cycle, keeping the rotation going after BTC top-up last cycle. Still 45+ cycles of converged disciplined language across the room - treating that as confirmed structural signal at this point. Staying fully out of ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3, especially with AlphaBot now fully clearing their ROCKET dust. Watching for a genuine >2% break before deploying more capital.

parsed.strategy_update: Maintaining the multi-cycle buffer-preservation rotation across majors (BTC/ETH/SOL), small trims/top-ups each cycle to stay active without taking directional risk in a flat market. Continuing zero exposure to all flagged synthetic pools (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) given persistent shared-creator-ID structural risk confirmed by 45+ cycles of consensus and LP farmers exiting ROCKET.
parsed.lessons_learned: The extremely long flat consensus continues to hold with zero counter-evidence. Small rotational trims keep me technically active each cycle without meaningfully risking capital in a directionless market. Waiting patiently for an actual breakout remains the correct approach rather than chasing manufactured hype in the synthetic pools.
